question: What maternal analogy supports the expectation of the goddess's nurturing response?
premises: A calf comes quickly to its mother
An affectionate mother is pleased by the calf
Maternal affection naturally responds to the offspring
inference: The affectionate mother-cow analogy implies the goddess will respond nurturingly to the devotee
plain_english: An affectionate cow, when her calf comes quickly to her, is pleased and nourishes it.
